contracts_rationale: No API or schema is published; the interface is the deploy workflow job graph, specified in data-model.md and pinned by tests.
purpose_context: The canary proved GitHub Pages serves the doc-kitty build's URL classes. This mission switches the docs-pages.yml deploy from DocFX to the doc-kitty artifact built by the shared docs-site-build.yml, so main deploys only a site the pull-request gate's build definition built (ADR D-11). After each deploy a smoketest job runs the ledger-derived live-site probe against docs.spec-kitty.ai and turns the run red on a mismatch (#2361). The hand-written docs/llms.txt is deleted, since the site generates /llms.txt. Rollback is reverting the pull request.
purpose_tldr: Main deploys the doc-kitty build through the shared build definition, a post-deploy smoketest probes the live site, and docs/llms.txt is deleted (#6938 PR B, #2361)
